answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own umber record, and its own share of the spiral quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The meadow ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 2902 identities would post 3218 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
